name: New York New Year 2025
information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competition Procedures tab.

Please note the schedule of this competition - there are events/rounds taking place from **9pm** on New Year's Eve (December 31, 2025) to **2am** on New Year's Day (January 1, 2026), and then 9:30am to 1:30pm on New Year's Day.
